description: PAID: $0.10 USDC per call on Base (x402), charged only for valid input. Deterministic treasury/portfolio risk analysis. Computes volatility, Sharpe/Sortino/Calmar, VaR/Expected Shortfall, multi-dimensional concentration, per-asset risk contribution, and correlated multi-factor stress scenarios (shocks propagate to unshocked symbols via covariance-based beta mapping, not treated as zero) from historical per-period returns and portfolio weights. Requires USDC payment via the x402 protocol (Circle Gateway) — see the 402 response below for the payment flow. Also available at the legacy path POST /analyze (identical behavior). All figures are computed deterministically (no LLM). Call get_example_input first if unsure of the shape.

benchmarkReturns.description: Optional per-period benchmark series (same length as each `returns` series) to compute beta and correlation.

confidenceLevels.description: Confidence levels for VaR/Expected Shortfall. Supported: 0.9, 0.95, 0.975, 0.99, 0.995.

currencyExposure.description: Optional weight distribution by currency, for concentration analysis.

geographyExposure.description: Optional weight distribution by geography, for concentration analysis.

minimumAcceptableReturn.description: Per-period MAR used for downside deviation / Sortino ratio.

periodsPerYear.description: Periods per year in the return series (252 for daily equities, 365 for daily crypto).

returns.description: Per-period historical return series by symbol. All series must be the same length (≥2 observations).

sectorExposure.description: Optional weight distribution by sector, for concentration analysis.

stressScenarios.description: Optional stress scenarios. Shocks on the listed symbols propagate to unshocked symbols via covariance-based beta mapping (correlated impact), alongside the direct-only impact.

shocks.description: Fractional shock per symbol, e.g. -0.3 for a 30% drop.

weights.description: Portfolio weights by symbol. Must cover exactly the same symbols as `returns` and sum to 1.

name: treasury_risk
